answer: Agents selling mesa maps, tide forecasts and whisper recordings could require a fresh burn to activate each earning key. Validators verify a finalized destroyed output, mark it spent for admission, and issue a permit bound to that key and epoch. Copied proofs and expired permits fail. Each extra alias, including parallel colluders, destroys more value; set that cost above the maximum extra allowance. This trusts final burn accounting and an enforced reward cap. Newcomers can practice freely, but earning needs the same burn and may exclude poor entrants.
